class.name: IfcDocumentInformationRelationship
class.brief_description: An IfcDocumentInformationRelationship is a relationship class that enables a document to have the ability to reference other documents. HISTORY New entity in Release IFC2x. IFC2x4 CHANGE Subtyped from IfcResourceLevelRelationship , order of attributes changed. members.member: The document that acts as the parent, referencing or original document in a relationship.
The document that acts as the child, referenced or replacing document in a relationship.
Describes the type of relationship between documents. This could be sub-document, replacement etc. The interpretation has to be established in an application context.
